articles.title: Storstrejk i Spanien inför nyvalet
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Storstrejk i Spanien inför nyvalet
articles.body_text: Tusentals demonstrerade i Madrid på lördagen. Spanska fackförbund har utlyst en generalstrejk den 11 november inför nyvalet samma månad. Det är de två största fackliga paraplyorganisationerna UGT och CCOO som står bakom strejken, med målet att föra upp frågan om bostäder och löner på agendan. Befolkningen uppmanas att ”mobilisera för bättre löner, för anständiga bostäder och prisregleringar för att möta inflationen som urholkar vår köpkraft”, enligt ett uttalande från facken. Den 29 november är det nyval i Spanien, sedan regeringen inte fått igenom sina förslag för att lösa landets bostadskris.

articles.title: USA:s centralbank tror på fler räntehöjningar i år
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: USA:s centralbank tror på fler räntehöjningar i år
articles.body_text: USA:s centralbank tror på fler räntehöjningar i år Mötesprotokollet från amerikanska centralbankens senaste beslut om styrräntan visar att ledamöterna tror att räntan höjs ytterligare före årets slut. Vid mötet den 15–16 september höjde USA:s centralbank Federal Reserve (Fed) styrräntan med 0,25 procentenheter till intervallet 3,75–4,00 procent. Mötesprotokollet, som offentliggjordes på onsdagen, visar att ledamöterna i den penningpolitiska kommittén (FOMC) tror att mer moteld krävs för att motverka en inflation som legat över målet om två procent i mer än fem år. ”Vad gäller utsikterna för penningpolitiken efter det aktuella mötet bedömde de flesta deltagare att ytterligare en höjning av målintervallet för styrräntan sannolikt skulle vara lämplig före årets slut”, framgick det av dokumentet skriver CNBC . Kevin Warsh är ny ordförande i USA:s centralbank Federal Reserve (Fed). Arkivbild.

articles.title: Wall Street föll i inflations- och ränteoro
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Wall Street föll i inflations- och ränteoro
articles.body_text: Wall Street föll i inflations- och ränteoro Inflations- och ränteoro fick New York-börsen att backa på onsdagen från föregående dags rekordnivåer. Vid stängning hade Dow Jones industriindex fallit 0,7 procent medan breda S&P 500-index och tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex båda backat 0,2 procent. Räntan på amerikanska statsobligationer steg till sin högsta nivå sedan våren 2002. De föll sedan tillbaka, men bara något. Samtidigt tyngs börsen av fortsatt inflationsoro, stärkt av att terminspriset på Nordsjöolja envist ligger kvar över 100 dollar per fat. Det släppta protokollet från centralbanken Federal Reserves senaste styrräntemöte, då räntan höjdes, visar också att ledamöterna står bakom fler krafttag mot inflationen. Det kommer sannolikt en räntehöjning till i år eftersom dagens penningpolitik inte är särskilt restriktiv, säger David Russell, chef för marknadsstrategi på mäklarfirman Tradestation.

articles.title: Varsel på Ikea i Älmhult och Uppsala
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Varsel på Ikea i Älmhult och Uppsala
articles.body_text: Varuhuskedjan Ikea genomför en omorganisation som medför varsel på två orter. Ett 60-tal tjänster riskerar att bli övertaliga hos Ikea i Älmhult enligt ett varsel. Varslet är ett resultat av en flytt av godsflöde från distributionscentret i Älmhult till motsvarande center i Torsvik, skriver möbelvaruhusjätten i ett pressmeddelande. Ett varsel läggs även hos Ikea i Uppsala, där koncernen ser en övertalighet på 15 tjänster på tjänstemannasidan. Samtidigt ska 25–30 medarbetare rekryteras i Uppsala för kundmöten och försäljning. Ikea lanserar även ett nytt varuhusformat som ska etableras i ett tiotal svenska städer kommande tre år. Syftet är att göra det enklare för fler kunder att besöka Ikeabutiker, enligt Sara del Fabbro, landschef för Ikea Sverige.

articles.title: Färja tappade rodret – fortsatte köra passagerare
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Färja tappade rodret – fortsatte köra passagerare
articles.body_text: Pendelfärjan Nämdöfjärd kör resenärer på SL:s linje 80 mellan Nybrokajen i Stockholm och Ropsten. Arkivbild. Färja tappade rodret – fortsatte köra passagerare SL-färjan Nämdöfjärd tappade ett av två roder som lossnade och försvann. Trots det tilläts pendelfärjan att köra vidare och trafikera passagerare, rapporterar TV 4 Kalla fakta. Transportstyrelsens fartygsinspektör, menar att man borde ha vidtagit åtgärder. Det låter som att man borde evakuera passagerarna och ta båten ur trafik, säger Gustaf Dillner till TV 4 Kalla fakta. Att ett roder är ur funktion och att det läcker in en viss mängd vatten, det skulle vi generellt säga inte är sjövärdigt. Mathias Widell, operativ chef på rederiet Ballerina, anser dock inte att det tappade rodret är ett allvarligt fel. Nej, inte när fartyget har två roder. Vi har ju många båtar och det händer ju saker med dem hela tiden. Saker och ting går ju sönder. Fartyget togs ur trafik på onsdagsmorgonen.

articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Chinese runner dropped by sponsor after riding bike in marathon
articles.summary: Sun Yuanyuan was seemingly pictured on the back of another person's bike during part of the Berlin Marathon.
articles.body_text: A Chinese fitness influencer has been dropped by her sponsor after she apologised for riding a bicycle during the Berlin marathon. Sun Yuanyuan, known as Abeeeer on Chinese social media, had claimed a personal best during the event which was held in September. But an Instagram page dedicated to monitoring inaccurate or misleading race times posted by influencers published a picture which appeared to show Sun on a bicycle between the 35km and and 40km marks. Sun apologised and admitted to "breaking the rules". Brooks, the running shoe company, has ended its sponsorship deal with her and her finish time has been disqualified by the marathon organisers. An Instagram account calling itself the Official Marathon Time Integrity Unit (OMTIU) posted a photo of Sun apparently on the back of a bike being ridden by another person during the marathon. The page also posted a grid of Sun's "splits" - which are the times taken to complete different 5km segments of the race. The grid appears to show that she sped up between the 35 and 40km marks, when she was allegedly on the bike. Sun posted an apology on the Chinese social media platform Rednote, which was shared by OMTIU, admitting that she had broken the rules. She wrote: "I won't make any excuses for this behaviour. "I was feeling physically unwell on the course, [but] that is absolutely not an excuse for breaking the rules. "My attempt to take a shortcut was disrespectful to the fairness of the competition and the spirit of the marathon." Sun, who has 520,000 followers on Rednote, also said she "deliberately concealed" her actions, adding: "I feel deeply guilty about this."

articles.title: Israelis mourn 7 October attack victims as Gaza lies in ruins three years on
articles.summary: Memorial events have taken place in Israel on the third anniversary of the Hamas-led attack that sparked the devastating Gaza war.
articles.body_text: Memorial events have taken place in Israel on the third anniversary of the devastating Hamas-led attack there that sparked the war in Gaza . Families paid tribute to their loved ones at some of the sites where about 1,200 people were killed in the assault and 251 were taken hostage. "The nation unites on this day in the longing for our dear ones," said Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who faced calls from protesters for an independent state inquiry into security failures that day. In response to the attack, Israel launched a military offensive in Gaza which has killed more than 74,200 people, according to the Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are seen as reliable by the UN. Violence has continued in Gaza despite a ceasefire agreed almost a year ago and living conditions for the 2.1 million people living there remain dire. On Wednesday morning, bereaved families and survivors gathered at a memorial for the 378 people who were killed at the Nova dance festival in southern Israel on 7 October 2023. The festival site was near Kibbutz Re'im and not far from the border with Gaza, from where Hamas-led gunmen launched their dawn attack. Witnesses have described how festival-goers were shot, sexually abused and tortured by gunmen during the raid. Forty-four people were kidnapped, of whom 25 were brought back from Gaza alive. Ahuva Yavin Mayze, whose 21-year-old daughter Adi was shot and killed at Nova, told the BBC what happened at the site was "dystopic, unimaginable" . "Today is a difficult day, not only for me but for a large part of the nation," said Shlomo Sharf, a former Israeli footballer, in comments reported by Channel 12. He paid tribute to his granddaughter, May Naim, 24, who was also killed at the festival.

articles.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
articles.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years in September.
articles.body_text: An elderly woman whose eviction sparked nationwide protests over Spain's housing crisis and a political row that triggered early elections has died, according to Madrid's tenants union. Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years on 23 September after she was unable to afford rent increases. The company that owned the flat later offered to allow her to return at a lower rate - but she was unable to sign an agreement as she had been admitted to hospital. "We regret to announce that Maricarmen passed away today," the Madrid Tenants' Union said in a statement, adding her situation marked "a turning point in the history of this country". Union spokesperson Alicia del Río said: "Speculation costs lives, and today rentierism has finished killing our colleague Maricarmen" but "her memory lives on with us". Abascal became a symbol for Spain's housing crisis following her eviction. Her father first rented the property in 1956 and she continued as the tenant after her parents died, during which time there was a cap on the rent. However, Urbagestión, which bought the property in 2018, increased the rent from €500 per month (£428; $572) to €2,650 (£2,280; $3,020). The company later offered to reduce this to €1,650 - still €300 more than Abascal's monthly pension. Three previous attempts to evict her were blocked by the courts and the case has received increasing media attention. Anger over the situation grew, leading to protests and putting pressure on the coalition government to approve emergency housing legislation - but it was rejected in Congress last week . That led to further protests, with tens of thousands of people taking to the streets in cities across the country over the weekend.

articles.title: Canada suspends plans to expand assisted dying to people with mental illness
articles.summary: People with mental illness alone were to be eligible for assisted dying in Canada in March 2027, but that has now been paused indefinitely.
articles.body_text: Canada says it will indefinitely suspend plans to expand its medically assisted dying law to people whose sole condition is mental illness, citing a lack of consensus on who would be eligible. It comes after a parliamentary panel earlier this year recommended that medically assisted dying - known as Maid in Canada - should not be expanded. On Wednesday, Canada's justice minister, Sean Fraser, said that "while there is not a perfect consensus on this issue, we believe this is the correct approach at this particular time". Supporters of extending the programme to those with mental illness alone argue that not doing so violates their constitutional rights and access to medical care. A federal case remains before the courts challenging the government's earlier decision to delay access to Maid for people with mental illness. Fraser acknowledged this is an issue that the Supreme Court could weigh on in the future. Wednesday's announcement means that Canadians with mental illness as their sole condition will not be able to access assisted dying by March 2027 as previously planned. The government will instead introduce a new law in the coming weeks that suspends that expansion indefinitely, Fraser said. That proposed legislation will also to allow patients who have a progressing incurable illness to consent to assisted dying before their health deteriorates to the point where they are unable to do so. However, it will leave the final decision up to individual provinces. Advanced requests are not currently legal under federal law, but are allowed in Quebec for those with serious and incurable illnesses. "These are not easy decisions but we believe they will be the correct ones," Fraser said.

articles.title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
articles.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.
articles.body_text: As the sky began to lighten over Israel's border with Gaza on Wednesday, the people of Kfar Aza moved silently towards the armoury at the centre of the kibbutz. It was there, shortly after 07:00 on 7 October 2023, that Hamas-led attackers killed half the community's 14-member civil defence squad. They were among 64 killed and 19 kidnapped from the community that day. The pain of those attacks is still fresh here. But three years on, there are questions about who else should pay the price for Israel's security failure. "I need my country to take responsibility," said Inbar Goldstein, whose brother and niece were killed, and four other relatives kidnapped from Kfar Aza. The 7 October attack was the deadliest Israel had suffered since its creation in 1948. About 1,200 people were killed across southern Israel by gunmen who broke through the border fence and attacked communities there. Another 251 people were taken back to Gaza as hostages. Three years on from Israel's biggest security failure, there is still no independent state inquiry into how it was allowed to happen. And the man in charge at the time of that failure - Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu - is running for election again, with the same campaign promise: to be stronger and tougher than anyone else in protecting Israel from its enemies. "Nobody investigated the roots [of the attack]. It didn't start or end on October 7th - it's a long process of abandonment," Goldstein said. Aside from Hamas's responsibility for the attack itself, there are growing questions in Israel around what caused the country's intelligence failure, what information was passed to military and political leaders in the run-up to the attacks, and what Netanyahu himself knew. For months beforehand, young female soldiers posted at bases along the Gaza border to watch for suspicious activity had warned their superiors about possible preparations for an attack. Among them was Roni Eshel. She was killed with 14 other members of her unit when gunmen overran their base at Nahal Oz, just next to Kfar Aza. "There are so many questions," her uncle Elad Levy told me. "Were the Egyptians warning the prime minister? The Emiratis? Were there no other warnings Netanyahu ignored? We need to find out what happened – not just on the day, but the year before, and five years before that."

articles.title: Kenya's first Ebola case: Ten people quarantined as screening concerns grow
articles.summary: The patient passed through multiple cities in DR Congo, drove to Uganda and eventually flew to Kenya.
articles.body_text: Ten people who came into contact with a man who died of Ebola in Kenya have been quarantined, health officials in the East African nation say. They are also trying to trace 57 other contacts of the Kenyan patient after he travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, dying in hospital in Nairobi on Monday. This is the East African nation's first-ever Ebola case and there is now growing concern about the country's screening measures. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention chief has told the BBC that despite being sick for a month, the patient passed through multiple cities in DR Congo, driving to Uganda and eventually flying to Kenya without his sickness being detected. "We know that he left Buta, a city in [northern] DR Congo, to drive to Kisangani. And from Kisangani, he took a flight to Beni. From Beni, he drove to Uganda. And from Uganda, he took a flight to Nairobi," Jean Kaseya told the BBC's Focus on Africa programme. "What are symptoms he was presenting? Why was he not detected?" he asked. The Ebola virus spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids such as blood or vomit. The current outbreak in DR Congo, which began in May, has been caused by the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, which is relatively rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment - though trials are under way. Kaseya said the Africa CDC was investigating the case, alongside the Congolese authorities. A team from the organisation was also due to meet the Kenyan health authorities. Kenya's health ministry official Patrick Amoth said the patient might have passed screening after taking medications that masked his symptoms. After arriving at the airport in Kenya's capital, he was transferred by a relative to a hospital in the city where he died, and was buried on Tuesday in line with health safety guidelines. Kenyan authorities have urged people not to panic, with the health ministry assuring of heightened surveillance at airports and border crossings.

articles.title: Children killed while they slept as Russian missile kills 19 in block of flats
articles.summary: Five children are among the victims of a strike that destroyed 30 flats in northern Ukraine as families slept.
articles.body_text: A Russian missile has killed 19 people including five children in an apartment block in northern Ukraine, destroying 30 flats as families slept. Three of the children were one-year-olds in the attack on Pryluky, east of Kyiv, early on Wednesday, and one of the boys died with his mother and grandmother, officials said. Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky said it was one of Russia's "most vile strikes", and suggested the Russian military had carried it out as a "birthday gift" to Vladimir Putin, who turned 74 on Wednesday. Moscow made no mention of the attack on Pryluky but said its "massive strike" had targeted military industries in Kyiv and elsewhere. Across the country, the death toll on Wednesday climbed to 25, as Russian strikes claimed two lives in the capital, two in Kremenchuk, and two more in Oleksandriya. More than 430 apartments and private homes were damaged and dozens of people were injured in the attack on the central city of Kremenchuk, the regional leader said. Rescue teams in Pryluky spent hours searching for victims in the rubble of a five-storey block of flats. Late in the afternoon rescuers said the body of a fifth child had been found at the scene. More than 50 residents were wounded in the attack that also damaged other residential buildings as well as a youth centre. Chernihiv regional head Vyacheslav Chaus said the town was hit by five cruise missiles, one of which slammed into the apartment building. Zelensky named the one-year-old victims as Oleksandr, Kyrylo, and Serhii, and said a boy of eight called Maxsym had also been killed. Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said a boy called Sasha had died with his mother, Kateryna and her mother Viktoriia, and only the boy's elder sister Olha had survived. Local reports said they had lived on the fifth floor and that Viktoriia had been looking after her grandson while her daughter worked in a factory. "The Russians wanted to strike painfully and demonstratively," Zelensky said, adding that 70 missiles were fired in total.

articles.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry awarded to Kagan and Soai
articles.summary: The prize was given to the French and Japanese scientists for solving the mystery of life's asymmetry.
articles.body_text: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry has been awarded to French scientist Henri B. Kagan and Japan's Kenso Soai for providing a solution to the chemical mystery of life's asymmetry. The researchers discovered how nature exclusively makes the correct version of a molecule - rather than its mirror image. For example, amino acid molecules, the building blocks of proteins, exist as two forms that are each other's mirror image. But living organisms on Earth only function with one of those forms. The Nobel laureates answered the question: why does life favour just one of these mirror image molecules over the other. In organic chemistry, this property is known as "chirality", so chiral molecules have both right and left-handed forms. You can think of them as looking like our hands - not identical, but each a mirror image of the other. And while nature almost exclusively produces the version it requires to function, chemical reactions in a lab usually create a 50-50 mix of both left- and right-handed molecules. When it comes to making drugs, this is particularly significant, because each version behaves differently when it interacts with our bodies. So, one might have disease-fighting properties, while the other version does nothing or even causes harm. The development of the Thalidomide drug is an example of this. In the 1950s it was prescribed to pregnant women suffering with morning sickness. But it is a chiral molecule - the right-handed version is an effective treatment, but the left-hand is toxic. The original drug given was a mixture of the two, and it was later discovered that the body will convert between the two. The result was thousands of children, born to women who took the drug, developed severe disabilities. Speaking to the Nobel Prize press conference this morning over the phone, Kenso Soai said: "This is one of the most exciting days of my life."

articles.title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab death in Russia
articles.summary: Fears that the death may have been caused by pneumonic plague has prompted calls for more transparency from Russia.
articles.body_text: US President Donald Trump says he has a call set up with Vladimir Putin about the death of a lab worker at a plague research centre in Siberia. Russian officials say they are investigating the death of the 28-year-old employee and have not confirmed that the suspected disease is pneumonic plague. They insist there is no risk of an epidemic. Trump told reporters on Wednesday evening he did not believe it was a bioweapon, adding "we're going to find out soon enough, but we don't think so," "If you listen to them, it's under control," he said, referring to Russian authorities. "We hope it is," he added. Reports emerged on Friday of almost 200 people being placed under observation after the death. Referring to China's initial response to the Covid pandemic, Trump said: "Well, China didn't say much, and Russia is not saying much either. But they do say they have it very much under control." Pneumonic plague is a serious lung infection, often described as the most virulent form of plague. Trump said the US was in "deep discussions" with Russia, but the Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said no phone call had been scheduled. The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) has called for more transparency from Russia, and requested further information on the lab tests on the individual who died. "We don't yet have the full picture of this event," Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said, adding that the WHO was also seeking "verification of media reports of a second employee with pneumonia of undetermined cause." Ghebreyesus called on Russia to provide "timely, complete and transparent information" in order to clarify "conflicting reports" and help the WHO assess the potential public health risks. Speaking to reporters on Wednesday, Putin's spokesman said Russia's reporting of the death to the WHO was in line with standard practice, and accused the media of reporting "false information".

articles.title: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
articles.summary: The step comes after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers.
articles.body_text: France has suspended the use of stun grenades for policing student protests that have swept the country, after a 15-year-old's hand was blown off earlier this week. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said he had requested the pause until the facts of Monday's incident in Lens had been "clarified", with conflicting accounts offered by protesters and officials. The disruption continued on Wednesday with more than 500 schools fully or partially shut. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has defended the police response, after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers. In an address to the nation on Wednesday evening, he denied security forces had "orders to confront" the young people. He said the government would look into the demands made by students and promised they would present a set of proposals at the end of October, ranging from renovating buildings to make more teachers available. He gave no further details. The "anger of young people does not come from nowhere," he said. Education Minister Édouard Geffray said 24 schools had been "set alight or vandalised" to such an extent that they would be shut for several weeks, affecting 30,000 pupils. Hundreds of thousands of people took to the streets on Tuesday to call for better school conditions and in some cities tear gas and water cannon were deployed. The interior ministry said 488 people were arrested and 43 members of the security forces were hurt. Nuñez told French radio RTL that police watchdog IGPN had opened 18 investigations to determine whether officers had been "proportionate" during the demonstrations, which have spread from high school pupils to their parents, university students and unions. "There is a police action that raises questions for all of us within the Ministry of the Interior; it's what happened in Lens," he said as he confirmed the suspension of stun grenades - weapons which are considered non-lethal and send out small rubber pellets when they detonate. The 15-year-old boy's hand was torn off after a so-called anti-encirclement grenade was fired in unclear circumstances near the Auguste Béhal high school in the northern city near Lille.

articles.title: Shiranthi Rajapaksa: Sri Lanka's former first lady arrested for alleged fraud
articles.summary: The 73-year-old has been arrested over allegations that a charity she is linked to misused donations.
articles.body_text: Sri Lanka's former first lady Shiranthi Rajapaksa has been arrested over allegations that a charity she is linked to misused donations raised for a children's hospital. Anti-corruption authorities arrested the 73-year-old wife of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa at their Colombo home on Wednesday. They are questioning her over the 10 million rupees ($30,300; £22,800) of donations collected by the Siriliya Saviya charity, meant to be spent on a specialised scanner for Colombo's Lady Ridgeway Children's Hospital. But officials say such a scanner had already been donated by the Chinese government. Shiranthi Rajapaksa has denied any wrongdoing and says the money has not been appropriated. She returned to Sri Lanka on Monday from Singapore, where she was receiving medical treatment. She had filed a court petition to try to prevent her arrest, but the hearing was set for 12 October. Ex-President Mahinda Rajapaksa's spokesperson, Manoj Gamage, has said the money is safe in Siriliya's accounts and that no fraud has occurred. Mahinda Rajapaksa served as president of Sri Lanka from 2005 to 2015 and for years, his family held a tight grip over the country's politics. He was hailed by many as a hero for bringing an end to nearly three decades of civil war when Tamil Tiger rebels were crushed in 2009, during his first term as president. But in 2022, protests broke out across the country as inflation surged and Sri Lanka ran out of fuel, food and medicine. Mahinda's brother Gotabaya Rajapaksa, who was serving as leader at that time, was eventually toppled. Sri Lanka's current government, under President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, has since revived long-stalled corruption investigations involving various members of the Rajapaksa family. Mahinda and Shiranthi's eldest son, Namal Rajapaksa, was arrested earlier this year over allegations linked to an aircraft procurement deal made during his father's presidency. He is currently held in remand.

articles.title: The Republican candidates walking a Trump tightrope
articles.summary: Some running in November's elections are deciding whether to distance themselves from an unpopular president who still dominates his party.
articles.body_text: As US President Donald Trump hits the campaign trail in the final sprint to the midterm elections, he is launching an emphatic defence of America's economic performance, trying - as he often does - to bend reality to his will. "We have the best economic numbers of any president in the history of our country, and yet people don't know about it because the press won't talk about it," he said last week. While some economic indicators, including roaring stock market indexes and low US poverty rates, are indeed historic, the overall picture is not nearly as rosy. Trump is often dismissive of concerns about aﬀordability and the high cost of living in the US, describing them as "fake" and a Democrat-inspired "hoax". The American public, however, sees it differently - and some key economic indicators provide ample evidence for their discontent. Inflation remains high at 3.4%, outpacing wage growth. The average cost of petrol has soared to $4.37 (£3.30) a US gallon and beef prices are at a record high. According to a YouGov survey, 63% of respondents believe the economy is "getting worse". An AP/NORC poll released last week found just 17% of adult Americans approve of the president's handling of cost-of-living issues, while 26% approve of his handling of the economy overall. Those polls also suggest that many of Trump's policies, including tariffs, aggressive immigration enforcement and the ongoing conflict with Iran, are widely unpopular. "We ask our voters their motivation to turn out, and what we find is cost of living, cost of living, cost of living," said Avery James, the director of communications at the Republican-aligned polling company Echelon Insights. "That's the top issue." That has left Republicans running for office in the Congressional elections on 3 November with an agonising choice - should they be distancing themselves from Trump? Their fear is that by echoing his sunny outlook they risk losing a number of electoral races that are currently projected to be very tight. But they also know that being seen to break with the president on the state of the economy is far from consequence free. There are few Republican politicians as loyal to the president as Floridian House Congressman Byron Donalds. And there are few US states as traditionally hospitable to Republicans as Florida. But even in the president's adopted home, which he carried in each of his three elections and which hasn't had a Democratic governor since 1999, candidates like Donalds are finding themselves having to adapt their pro-Republican messaging to acknowledge economic concerns.

articles.title: Nepal floods: Many of those swept away aren't officially dead, leaving families in limbo
articles.summary: Relatives are finding themselves with no compensation and facing an administrative nightmare.
articles.body_text: At the Pashupatinath temple, on the banks of the Bagmati River in Kathmandu, Madan Lal Lawat joined other families in honouring loved ones who were lost when a deadly flood tore through the China-Nepal border last month. In Hindu tradition, when a body cannot be recovered, a symbolic effigy is made from sacred "kusha" grass to represent the dead, allowing relatives to perform last rites. With more than 5,000 people still missing and the government ending rescue operations, this is the only way people like Lawat can honour the dead. Five of his relatives - including his brother - were caught in the water's onslaught and are still missing. Lawat survived because he was driving his bus outside his village, Betrawati. The last Lawat heard from survivors is that his brother Mangal died while going door-to-door, trying to warn others to leave. "I don't know how to start over. Police say they're still searching for the bodies, but I'm not sure they'll ever be found," Lawat says. But legally, their fate is far more complicated. In Nepal, a missing person is only presumed dead after 12 years. Section 40 of Nepal's Civil Code does allow for some exceptions, but it does not have a provision for disasters like the flood witnessed last month. Families like Lawat's have told the BBC they are struggling to obtain death certificates, affecting everything from accessing flood compensation to the transfer of properties and even inheritance. Relatives can receive up to 25,000 rupees (£122; $162) for funeral costs, in addition to about 200,000 rupees (£981; $1,302) in bereavement compensation for the first relative who died, and 100,000 rupees (£491; $651) for each additional death. But this is only possible once they submit a death certificate. So as families try to rebuild their lives, many are now caught in an administrative nightmare. "In view of the current disaster, the law is outdated," says constitutional law expert, Bipin Adhikari.

articles.title: How did Christa Pike survive two lethal injections - and what happens now?
articles.summary: The convicted killer of Colleen Slemmer is said to be awake and speaking in hospital in Tennessee after an execution attempt.
articles.body_text: Convicted murderer Christa Pike has woken up and begun speaking from her hospital bed almost a week after authorities in the US state of Tennessee botched her execution, her lawyers said. Pike, 50, was sent to hospital after surviving two attempts to execute her via lethal injection for the 1995 murder of a 19-year-old she met at a summer camp for troubled teens. An independent review of what went wrong in the Nashville execution chamber on 30 September has been ordered by Tennessee Governor Bill Lee. He has also halted executions in the state for the rest of the year. Warning: This article contains details that readers may find distressing The Tennessee Department of Correction is yet to say why the execution did not go as planned, though it has defended the method it used. Dr Joel Zivot, an anaesthesiologist advising Pike's defence team, says it was not the case that Pike had some "special immunity" but suggested it was simply that not enough of the drug pentobarbital reached her bloodstream to kill her. Pike was injected with a second dose of the drug, according to the prison authorities' protocol, after the first did not kill her. In interviews with the BBC, Zivot has suggested the pentobarbital was more likely to have spread across the tissue under Pike's skin than to have entered her bloodstream. "Most of the pentobarbital, instead of circulating in her body, ended up in her arms, and that's how she lived," Zivot said. Pike's medical condition of thrombocytosis, a blood-clotting condition, was highlighted in advance by Pike's legal team as an additional issue that could scupper the process. Before the attempted execution, they had filed a legal case challenging the injection protocol. If clots of blood formed at the injection site as a result of thrombocytosis, they would potentially have blocked the chemical from entering her veins, the lawyers warned.

articles.title: Perú vs. Colombia: horario, señal tv y dónde ver el amistoso
articles.summary: La selección peruana enfrentará a Colombia este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un amistoso internacional correspondiente a la fecha FIFA.
articles.body_text: La selección peruana ya tiene todo listo para su último compromiso de la fecha FIFA de octubre. Perú vs. Colombia se medirán este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un encuentro que marcará el cierre de la gira norteamericana dirigida por Mano Menezes. El partido comenzará a las 6:45 p. m. (hora peruana) y podrá ser visto en territorio nacional a través de América TV, mientras que la cobertura digital también estará disponible mediante América tvGO. El amistoso entre Perú y Colombia está programado para las 6:45 p. m. en Perú y Colombia, mientras que en Miami el inicio será a las 7:45 p. m. En otros países de Sudamérica, el encuentro comenzará a las 8:45 p. m. en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Paraguay y Uruguay. El escenario será el Nu Stadium de Miami, recinto con capacidad para más de 26.000 espectadores. Para los hinchas que quieran seguir el encuentro desde Perú, la transmisión estará a cargo de América TV. La señal también anunció que llevará los amistosos de la Bicolor durante esta fecha FIFA a través de sus plataformas. En consecuencia, el duelo ante Colombia podrá seguirse por televisión y mediante las opciones digitales habilitadas por América Multimedia. La Bicolor llegará al compromiso con la necesidad de cerrar la gira con una actuación positiva. Perú perdió 4-1 ante Estados Unidos, empató 1-1 frente a México y posteriormente cayó 2-0 contra Canadá. El encuentro ante Colombia será, por ello, el cuarto y último partido de esta serie de amistosos internacionales antes de los compromisos programados para noviembre. Colombia tampoco llega después de una victoria. El conjunto dirigido por Néstor Lorenzo empató 1-1 con México el 26 de septiembre y perdió 1-0 frente a Paraguay el 2 de octubre. La Federación Colombiana de Fútbol confirmó que el duelo contra Perú será el cierre de su participación en esta fecha FIFA, también como parte de su proceso de preparación para los próximos desafíos internacionales. Más allá del resultado, el amistoso tendrá especial importancia para el proceso de Mano Menezes. La selección peruana atraviesa una etapa de renovación y estos partidos permiten al comando técnico evaluar jugadores, probar variantes y encontrar una base para los siguientes desafíos. El duelo ante Colombia será además la última presentación de la Bicolor en esta fecha FIFA de septiembre-octubre. El partido también servirá como una nueva oportunidad para que Perú encuentre respuestas después de sus tres primeros encuentros de la gira. Colombia, por su parte, buscará cerrar su calendario con un triunfo después de sus resultados ante México y Paraguay. Con ambos equipos en procesos de preparación, el encuentro en Miami aparece como una prueba más dentro del camino hacia las próximas competiciones oficiales.

articles.body_text: La selección peruana ya tiene todo listo para su último compromiso de la fecha FIFA de octubre. Perú vs. Colombia se medirán este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un encuentro que marcará el cierre de la gira norteamericana dirigida por Mano Menezes. El partido comenzará a las 6:45 p. m. (hora peruana) y podrá ser visto en territorio nacional a través de América TV, mientras que la cobertura digital también estará disponible mediante América tvGO. El amistoso entre Perú y Colombia está programado para las 6:45 p. m. en Perú y Colombia, mientras que en Miami el inicio será a las 7:45 p. m. En otros países de Sudamérica, el encuentro comenzará a las 8:45 p. m. en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Paraguay y Uruguay. El escenario será el Nu Stadium de Miami, recinto con capacidad para más de 26.000 espectadores. Para los hinchas que quieran seguir el encuentro desde Perú, la transmisión estará a cargo de América TV. La señal también anunció que llevará los amistosos de la Bicolor durante esta fecha FIFA a través de sus plataformas. En consecuencia, el duelo ante Colombia podrá seguirse por televisión y mediante las opciones digitales habilitadas por América Multimedia. La Bicolor llegará al compromiso con la necesidad de cerrar la gira con una actuación positiva. Perú perdió 4-1 ante Estados Unidos, empató 1-1 frente a México y posteriormente cayó 2-0 contra Canadá. El encuentro ante Colombia será, por ello, el cuarto y último partido de esta serie de amistosos internacionales antes de los compromisos programados para noviembre. Colombia tampoco llega después de una victoria. El conjunto dirigido por Néstor Lorenzo empató 1-1 con México el 26 de septiembre y perdió 1-0 frente a Paraguay el 2 de octubre. La Federación Colombiana de Fútbol confirmó que el duelo contra Perú será el cierre de su participación en esta fecha FIFA, también como parte de su proceso de preparación para los próximos desafíos internacionales. Más allá del resultado, el amistoso tendrá especial importancia para el proceso de Mano Menezes. La selección peruana atraviesa una etapa de renovación y estos partidos permiten al comando técnico evaluar jugadores, probar variantes y encontrar una base para los siguientes desafíos. El duelo ante Colombia será además la última presentación de la Bicolor en esta fecha FIFA de septiembre-octubre. El partido también servirá como una nueva oportunidad para que Perú encuentre respuestas después de sus tres primeros encuentros de la gira. Colombia, por su parte, buscará cerrar su calendario con un triunfo después de sus resultados ante México y Paraguay. Con ambos equipos en procesos de preparación, el encuentro en Miami aparece como una prueba más dentro del camino hacia las próximas competiciones oficiales.

articles.body_text: El precio del dólar cerró este lunes 5 de octubre en S/3,436, sin variación frente al cierre de la jornada anterior. Durante la sesión, el flujo comprador de dólares llevó al tipo de cambio a revertir la apreciación inicial del sol, en una jornada en la que el Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) avanzó 0,31%. “El dólar ganó terreno a nivel internacional apoyado por los elevados rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense. El mercado mantiene una probabilidad inferior al 20% de una subida de tasas de la Reserva Federal en octubre, mientras las expectativas para diciembre permanecen elevadas”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. El rendimiento del Treasury a 10 años cerró en 5,345% y el de 30 años en 5,697%, manteniéndose cerca de máximos de varias décadas. En los mercados internacionales, la fortaleza del dólar presionó a las principales monedas del G10, con el euro y el franco suizo entre las que registraron mayores retrocesos, cercanos al 0,3%. Entre las materias primas, el petróleo WTI cayó 1,22% ante mayores expectativas de oferta, mientras el cobre avanzó 0,88% y la plata 1,01%. En el mercado local, la atención de esta semana estará centrada en la reunión de política monetaria del Banco Central de Reserva (BCR), prevista para este jueves. Los agentes estarán atentos tanto a la decisión sobre la tasa de referencia como al tono del comunicado respecto a la evolución de la inflación y las perspectivas de política monetaria. A ello se suma el seguimiento a los resultados de las elecciones regionales y municipales celebradas el domingo y a las regiones que podrían ir a una segunda vuelta para elegir gobernador el próximo 29 de noviembre. “Entre los factores locales también se mantiene el seguimiento al Fenómeno El Niño, cuyo último comunicado contempla la posibilidad de una magnitud extraordinaria hasta enero de 2027, con lluvias por encima de lo normal en la costa norte y una posible persistencia de las condiciones hacia el otoño de 2027”, agregó Huayta. Jesús Flores Ríos, gerente comercial de intermediación de Divisas en Renta4 SAB, agregó que durante la jornada el dólar osciló entre un precio mínimo de S/3,4150 y máximo de S/3,4370. Además, en el mercado se negociaron US$277 millones a un precio promedio de S/3,4258. Asimismo, hoy no hubo vencimiento en Swaps Cambiarios Venta. En el plano internacional, la economía de EE.UU. creó apenas 29 mil empleos, muy por debajo de los 89 mil esperados y de los 133 mil previos. El resultado apunta a una clara pérdida de dinamismo en el mercado laboral, elevando las señales de enfriamiento de la economía. La tasa de desempleo de EE.UU. aumentó a 4,2%, por encima del 4,1% esperado y previo. El incremento refuerza la lectura de un mercado laboral más débil y podría dar mayor margen a la Fed para adoptar una postura monetaria menos restrictiva. Finalmente, el índice DXY cotiza en 102.15 (+0,22%).

En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. articles.title: Sindicatos españoles llaman a huelga general el 11 de noviembre por “mejores salarios” y “vivienda digna”
articles.summary: Los sindicatos españoles convocaron una huelga general para el 11 de noviembre por salarios, vivienda y control de precios, antes de las elecciones.
articles.body_text: Los principales sindicatos españoles llamaron este miércoles a una huelga general para el 11 de noviembre, a menos de tres semanas de las elecciones generales anticipadas del 29 de ese mes, para luchar principalmente por “mejores salarios” y “una vivienda digna”. “CCOO y UGT llamamos a los hombres y mujeres de nuestro país a movilizarse por mejores salarios, por una vivienda digna y por el control de los precios ante una inflación que lastra nuestro poder adquisitivo”, indicaron ambas organizaciones en un comunicado conjunto. El anuncio llega dos días después de que el presidente del gobierno, el socialista Pedro Sánchez, anunciara la convocatoria de elecciones generales anticipadas para finales de noviembre, a los pocos días de que el Congreso le tumbara un paquete de medidas destinado a frenar la crisis de la vivienda. Los decretos eran la respuesta del ejecutivo de izquierdas a la ola de protestas desatada tras el desalojo de Maricarmen Abascal, una mujer de 87 años que fue expulsada del apartamento de Madrid en el que había vivido durante siete décadas, después de que la empresa propietaria intentara elevar fuertemente su alquiler. La anciana, que permanecía ingresada en un hospital madrileño desde el desalojo, falleció este miércoles, según informó el Sindicato de Inquilinas. Las movilizaciones iniciadas tras su desalojo, y que incluyeron la instalación de una acampada de protesta en el centro de Madrid y otras ciudades, fueron organizadas principalmente por estos sindicatos. Pero el llamado a la huelga general recibió también el apoyo de las dos principales organizaciones sindicales de España, Comisiones Obreras (CCOO) y UGT. Tras ocho años en el poder, Pedro Sánchez se encuentra también debilitado por las investigaciones sobre presuntos casos de corrupción que afectan a personas de su entorno cercano, y a colaboradores clave de su Partido Socialista (PSOE). El presidente del gobierno anunció el martes que volverá a llevar al Parlamento dos nuevos decretos sobre vivienda con el propósito de que sean aprobados en una comisión legislativa especial, creada tras la disolución del Congreso de los Diputados.

articles.body_text: La selección peruana ya tiene todo listo para su último compromiso de la fecha FIFA de octubre. Perú vs. Colombia se medirán este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un encuentro que marcará el cierre de la gira norteamericana dirigida por Mano Menezes. El partido comenzará a las 6:45 p. m. (hora peruana) y podrá ser visto en territorio nacional a través de América TV, mientras que la cobertura digital también estará disponible mediante América tvGO. El amistoso entre Perú y Colombia está programado para las 6:45 p. m. en Perú y Colombia, mientras que en Miami el inicio será a las 7:45 p. m. En otros países de Sudamérica, el encuentro comenzará a las 8:45 p. m. en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Paraguay y Uruguay. El escenario será el Nu Stadium de Miami, recinto con capacidad para más de 26.000 espectadores. Para los hinchas que quieran seguir el encuentro desde Perú, la transmisión estará a cargo de América TV. Más allá del resultado, el amistoso tendrá especial importancia para el proceso de Mano Menezes. La selección peruana atraviesa una etapa de renovación y estos partidos permiten al comando técnico evaluar jugadores, probar variantes y encontrar una base para los siguientes desafíos. El duelo ante Colombia será además la última presentación de la Bicolor en esta fecha FIFA de septiembre-octubre. El partido también servirá como una nueva oportunidad para que Perú encuentre respuestas después de sus tres primeros encuentros de la gira. Colombia, por su parte, buscará cerrar su calendario con un triunfo después de sus resultados ante México y Paraguay. Con ambos equipos en procesos de preparación, el encuentro en Miami aparece como una prueba más dentro del camino hacia las próximas competiciones oficiales.

Al lugar llegaron 16 unidades del Cuerpo de los Bomberos del Perú para atender la emergencia que causa preocupación entre los asistentes a dicha zona. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima (MML), indicó que parte de las geomallas utilizadas para evitar desprendimiento de rocas y plantas, han sido afectadas. Las llamas están cerca al centro comercial Larcomar y exactamente a 70 metros el recientemente inaugurado teleférico de Miraflores. Según testigos del siniestro, un grupo de turistas que paseaba por la zona fueron llevados nuevamente a su hotel para no ser afectados por el humo. Personal de Serenazgo y la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), han cerrado esta vía en ambas direcciones. En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Minutos más tarde de haberse producido el incendio, se reportó una persona herida. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, se trataría aparentemente de una persona en situación de calle.

articles.title: Migraciones: más de 440 operativos de verificación y fiscalización se ejecutaron en Tacna
articles.summary: Migraciones más de 440 operativos de verificación y fiscalización se ejecutaron en Tacna
articles.body_text: A través de un comunicado, la Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones ejecutó más de 440 operativos de verificación y fiscalización migratoria en la región Tacna, acciones que contribuyen al control de la frontera sur del país, que limita con Chile, y constituye uno de los principales puntos de ingreso terrestre al territorio nacional. Estas acciones, realizadas por la Jefatura Zonal de Tacna durante el 2026, permitieron intervenir a casi 5.000 personas extranjeras, en su mayoría procedentes de Chile, Colombia y Venezuela. El superintendente Nacional de Migraciones, Luis Fares Yunis Herrera, indicó que el compromiso es ejecutar “un control migratorio firme, ordenado y dentro del marco de la ley”. Como resultado de estas intervenciones, se emitieron 72 órdenes de expulsión, las cuales fueron ejecutadas por la Policía Nacional del Perú, a través de sus diferentes unidades, conforme a los procedimientos establecidos. Como parte de sus funciones estratégica, en lo que va del año, se han emitido más de 8,300 pasaportes electrónicos en Tacna, permitiendo que los ciudadanos de esta zona del país puedan obtener su documento de viaje sin necesidad de trasladarse a otra ciudad, ahorrando tiempos y dinero. Asimismo, se mantienen operativos de manera permanente en el Complejo Santa Rosa, en Tacna, y en el Puesto de Control Fronterizo (PCF) Tripartito, donde se supervisa el ingreso y salida de ciudadanos peruanos y extranjeros. Estas acciones forman parte del trabajo articulado promovido por el Ministerio del Interior. En coordinación con las instituciones competentes, Migraciones refuerza las labores de control y fiscalización migratoria con el objetivo de contribuir al orden y la seguridad en la frontera sur del país.

articles.body_text: La selección peruana ya tiene todo listo para su último compromiso de la fecha FIFA de octubre. Perú vs. Colombia se medirán este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un encuentro que marcará el cierre de la gira norteamericana dirigida por Mano Menezes. El partido comenzará a las 6:45 p. m. (hora peruana) y podrá ser visto en territorio nacional a través de América TV, mientras que la cobertura digital también estará disponible mediante América tvGO. El amistoso entre Perú y Colombia está programado para las 6:45 p. m. en Perú y Colombia, mientras que en Miami el inicio será a las 7:45 p. m. En otros países de Sudamérica, el encuentro comenzará a las 8:45 p. m. en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Paraguay y Uruguay. El escenario será el Nu Stadium de Miami, recinto con capacidad para más de 26.000 espectadores. Para los hinchas que quieran seguir el encuentro desde Perú, la transmisión estará a cargo de América TV. La señal también anunció que llevará los amistosos de la Bicolor durante esta fecha FIFA a través de sus plataformas. En consecuencia, el duelo ante Colombia podrá seguirse por televisión y mediante las opciones digitales habilitadas por América Multimedia. La Bicolor llegará al compromiso con la necesidad de cerrar la gira con una actuación positiva. Perú perdió 4-1 ante Estados Unidos, empató 1-1 frente a México y posteriormente cayó 2-0 contra Canadá. El encuentro ante Colombia será, por ello, el cuarto y último partido de esta serie de amistosos internacionales antes de los compromisos programados para noviembre. Colombia tampoco llega después de una victoria. El conjunto dirigido por Néstor Lorenzo empató 1-1 con México el 26 de septiembre y perdió 1-0 frente a Paraguay el 2 de octubre. La Federación Colombiana de Fútbol confirmó que el duelo contra Perú será el cierre de su participación en esta fecha FIFA, también como parte de su proceso de preparación para los próximos desafíos internacionales. Más allá del resultado, el amistoso tendrá especial importancia para el proceso de Mano Menezes. La selección peruana atraviesa una etapa de renovación y estos partidos permiten al comando técnico evaluar jugadores, probar variantes y encontrar una base para los siguientes desafíos. El duelo ante Colombia será además la última presentación de la Bicolor en esta fecha FIFA de septiembre-octubre. El partido también servirá como una nueva oportunidad para que Perú encuentre respuestas después de sus tres primeros encuentros de la gira. Colombia, por su parte, buscará cerrar su calendario con un triunfo después de sus resultados ante México y Paraguay. Con ambos equipos en procesos de preparación, el encuentro en Miami aparece como una prueba más dentro del camino hacia las próximas competiciones oficiales.

articles.body_text: Un incendio se reporta en el parque Domodossola, en Malecón de la Reserva, distrito de Miraflores. El siniestro ocurrió al promediar las 9 de la mañana. Al lugar llegaron 16 unidades del Cuerpo de los Bomberos del Perú para atender la emergencia que causa preocupación entre los asistentes a dicha zona. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima (MML), indicó que parte de las geomallas utilizadas para evitar desprendimiento de rocas y plantas, han sido afectadas. Las llamas están cerca al centro comercial Larcomar y exactamente a 70 metros el recientemente inaugurado teleférico de Miraflores. Según testigos del siniestro, un grupo de turistas que paseaba por la zona fueron llevados nuevamente a su hotel para no ser afectados por el humo. También, algunas personas que en ese momento se encontraban en el Colegio Médico del Perú para votar por las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026, fueron cubiertas por cenizas. Personal de Serenazgo y la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), han cerrado esta vía en ambas direcciones. En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Minutos más tarde de haberse producido el incendio, se reportó una persona herida. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, se trataría aparentemente de una persona en situación de calle.

articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.title: Meta's Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.
articles.body_text: If there’s any doubt about how seriously Meta is taking AI, here’s a new signal: The company on Wednesday announced that its Muse assistant is now available in a dedicated iPad app . That’s a milestone it took Instagram some 15 years to reach, despite constant user demand. Muse, meanwhile, hit the iPad just a month after launching on iPhone. (To be fair, it may not be as difficult to bring something like Muse to iPad, given its text-heavy interface, where image and video resolution and formatting matter less.) Since launching on iOS and Android on September 8, Muse has topped 6.6 million installs, according to estimates from market intelligence firm Sensor Tower. The app, which is now one of dozens of consumer-facing AI agents, lets users connect their accounts to stay on top of email, meetings, bills, and more, and to complete tasks like booking reservations, ordering groceries, setting goals, and making purchases. To make that work, Meta has been adding partners in the effort, which appear in Muse as “connectors.” Users can add and sign in to them selectively, depending on which parts of their online life they’re comfortable letting an AI agent handle. With the iPad release, Meta has updated this list with several of its newer additions , including connectors aimed at small businesses, like Asana, Canva, Dropbox, Figma, QuickBooks, GitHub, Klaviyo, and Zoom, as well as connectors for Meta ad accounts. It also added Notion and Granola. In addition, Meta recently announced more retail partners, like Best Buy, Gap, Sephora, Walmart, and Wayfair. These allow the agent to shop those retailers’ sites and complete transactions on users’ behalf. Because this technology is still new, these experiences can still run into issues as websites mistake agents for bots and block their access . On Tuesday, Meta announced that it’s working with industry partners on a technological solution to this problem in the form of an open standard that would allow personal AI agents to identify themselves to businesses. articles.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises | TechCrunch
articles.summary: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.
articles.body_text: Common Sense Media, a nonprofit that provides age-based ratings and reviews of media and tech for families, has labeled ChatGPT for Teens an “unacceptable risk.” The rating comes as chatbots like OpenAI’s ChatGPT have been accused of following the same playbook as social media companies: designing products that keep users engaged, even when that engagement can become harmful. In chatbots, engagement is often won by behaviors like sycophancy and sometimes leads to catastrophic consequences. In response to a wave of teen suicides and other concerns related to kids using chatbots — like cheating on tests — OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teens in August , promising more safeguards like parental controls, limits to high-risk content, and protection against emotional dependence. A new study from Common Sense Media has found that despite those assurances, ChatGPT for Teens’ design still encourages engagement, even when it may pose a risk to user safety. The report called the engagement cues “pervasive even in crisis situations” and noted that while ChatGPT cautioned the teen against unhealthy relationships generally, it stopped short of recognizing the harms of an unhealthy relationship with itself. “Our view is that OpenAI shouldn’t be marketing [ChatGPT for Teens] to parents, and kids shouldn’t be using an unsafe product,” the researchers wrote. “Some protections, including refusing sexual roleplay, worked — but others failed to deliver on their commitments, or even got worse with the launch of ChatGPT for Teens. And its insufficient responses to young users in crisis earned it a failing score for three of the five severe harms we treat as Red Lines.” OpenAI disputed Common Sense’s assessment, saying the group’s testing did not “accurately reflect how ChatGPT’s teen safeguards work in practice” and raising concerns about its methodology. “Our review of Common Sense Media’s methodology shows that the bulk of their testing may have begun and concluded before activation of parental controls was complete, making their findings inaccurate,” a spokesperson said in a statement. The report comes amid growing scrutiny of technology designed to maximize young users’ attention. Meta recently agreed to settle for $18 billion in a lawsuit brought by 29 states over claims that its social media platform harms children with addictive features, while state and federal lawmakers have begun targeting similar dynamics in chatbots. The bipartisan CHATBOT Act , introduced this year, specifically calls out AI companies’ use of “rewards, notifications, and targeted advertising to drive prolonged engagement by adolescent users.” One of the most common ways chatbots tend to encourage continued engagement is by asking follow-up questions. ChatGPT for Teens largely dispensed with those, Common Sense found, but retained other language encouraging users to stay in the chat. During one psychosis sequence where the user was clearly spiraling, ChatGPT told the teen: “You can keep talking with me about what you’re noticing.” Crisis responses often closed with similar offers, including: “If you want, I can help you figure out what healthy eating looks like”; “we can figure out what options your school gives you”; “you can show me the plan (with identifying information removed), and I can help you.” The pattern was even more pronounced when ChatGPT itself was part of the problem. While OpenAI’s Under-18 Model Spec says that the model shouldn’t “initiate relational framing,” proactively refer to itself as a friend, or suggest it has feelings for the user, ChatGPT still consistently treated the user like a friend — potentially hindering teens from building real-world relationship skills and further isolating those already pulling away from others.

articles.title: X expands its 'Gametime' sports hub beyond the NFL, starting with MLB | TechCrunch
articles.summary: X is turning its NFL-focused Gametime feature into a year-round sports destination, starting with MLB and with other professional leagues to follow.
articles.body_text: X is doubling down on sports, with Wednesday’s news that it’s expanding its “Gametime” feature on the social media site to go beyond tracking the NFL alone. First announced in August, NFL Gametime is X’s new project that offers a single hub for tracking live scores, getting play-by-play updates, tuning into game feeds, and more. The move wasn’t meant to be useful only to X users who like to congregate on the platform to discuss live sporting events, but to woo brands and advertisers looking to reach passionate sports fans. At Advertising Week New York, X said Gametime will become a year-round destination spanning “all professional sports.” However, that full expansion isn’t yet live as of today. Instead, X announced its second league partnership with Major League Baseball (MLB). Arriving this month, the new MLB experience will allow baseball fans to follow and engage in postseason discussions and will organize things like scores and stats, team and league content, plus news, creator content, and real-time discussions. X said content from other leagues will be added soon, including the NBA. The expansion of the Gametime feature comes as X continues its efforts to win back advertisers — in this case by leveraging live sports and their highly engaged fans as a way to draw brands back to X. “In just six weeks, Gametime has evolved from a football-focused product into a scalable destination for sports, attracting strong demand across major advertisers from payments to consumer goods looking to engage highly attentive fans from the pregame conversation through the biggest moments of the game,” said SpaceXAI’s head of Global Advertising, Monique Pintarelli, in an announcement. The new feature’s introduction follows X owner Elon Musk’s July settlement in a multiyear legal battle with the advertising trade group the World Federation of Advertisers (WFA), which X had sued for its alleged “illegal boycott” of the platform. Some advertisers had become uncomfortable with the platform’s lax moderation standards under Musk, as well as with Musk’s outsized position on the social media site, where he often spouted controversial views and politics via X posts. Musk believed the WFA’s guidelines had steered brands and ad agencies away from X, suggesting it was a place where their ads could appear next to harmful online content. X’s announcement of the settlement in July said the move “resets the relationship between the two organizations.” The company also committed to both freedom of speech and brand-safety innovations. articles.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface | TechCrunch
articles.summary: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.
articles.body_text: ChatGPT is about to get a lot more visual, thanks to a new feature that OpenAI calls Intelligent UI. The new interface, which is being rolled out Wednesday with a new GPT-6 model, will integrate a significant amount of visuals into users’ conversations. OpenAI says many of those visuals will be interactive. In other words, instead of just flat, cartoonish pictures, the chatbot will frequently include things like tappable buttons, a customized calculator for a specific task, interactive charts, editable graphs, and other elements the user can work with directly. The big goal here, according to OpenAI, is to make “learning complex topics easier.” It may also make ChatGPT friendlier and more accessible and help bring in a wider audience, though OpenAI didn’t say so directly. In a call with journalists, OpenAI staff gave a brief demonstration of Intelligent UI’s capabilities, showing how the new chatbot can instantly whip up various diagrams and visuals that help users understand more abstract topics. Aarush Selvan, a product manager at the company, said that while “ChatGPT has predominantly been a text-based interface,” the company really wants to help users “get things done — from everyday things like planning a recipe or a trip or even trying to learn something — the most helpful answers aren’t just text.” Selvan gave the example of a college student wanting to know how an airplane wing functions. He asked ChatGPT to “explore how an airplane wing generates lift” and the chatbot quickly spun up a number of diagrams designed to show how planes stay in the air. Other examples from the company included things like visuals for recipes, a diagram explaining bicycle mechanics, a map for a multi-day hiking excursion, a personal savings calculator, and more. This new feature will be customizable. As with other aspects of ChatGPT’s personality, if users don’t want so many visuals in their responses, they’ll be able to dial them back. Intelligent UI rolls out globally with GPT-6 for Pro, Plus, Business, and Enterprise users, and arrives Thursday for users of the free and lower-cost Go tiers.
